note: Park in the designated, labeled climber parking on the far side of the golf course clubhouse lot on Brow Lake Rd, then sign in at the clubhouse and pay the day-use fee before climbing.
basis: MP via search: 'park in the designated climber parking area, sign in at the clubhouse, pay the day-use fee'; 'climber parking is labeled and located on far side of parking lot'; clubhouse 9104 Brow Lake Rd, Soddy Daisy.

note: Park in the lot on Mullens Cove Rd in Prentice Cooper State Forest; the approach trail starts across the road from it. Parking along the road is not allowed, and break-ins have happened, so leave nothing in the car.
basis: Search summary of MP/TRGT/SE climbers pages for The Tennessee Wall: 'approach trail starts across from the parking area on Mullens Cove Rd. Parking on the road is not allowed'; break-ins reported. Applies to T-Wall generally, not East specifically.

note: Park at the informal pull-offs along the Potash Road (UT 279), about 2 miles in from US-191; the routes are right beside the road. Park well out of the traffic lane, as potash trucks and 4x4s use it.
basis: Search summary of MP/Outdoor Project: 'plenty of parking right along the routes', 'watch for speeding potash-haulers... be sure to park out of the way', highest concentration about 2 miles in.

note: Park in the dirt lot at the end of Front Street in Grand Ledge (turn left onto Front St just after crossing the bridge on Bridge St, through the subdivision). Trails lead a few minutes downhill to the boulders; do not park at Fitzgerald Park across the river.
basis: MP directions via search: 'hang a left on the first street which is Front Street... dead end at dirt parking lot for Oak Park'; approach 5 min downhill; Fitzgerald Park does not allow climbing.

note: The approach trail starts at the south end of the Poke-O-Moonshine campground off NY 9 (kiosk at the trailhead). Roadside parking is limited and the campground is described as closed in places, so check posted notices.
basis: SummitPost: trailhead at southern edge of campground on NY 9, 'Roadside parking is limited, but for a small fee you can park in the camping area'; MP access notes: 'kiosk at the beginning of the approach trail in the (now closed) Poke-O Campground'.

note: Park in the lot on the east side of Centennial Dr, about 1/2 mile north of CR-38E (1 mile south of CR-42C). It is shared with the Piano Keys boulders; hike west up the hogback about 5 minutes to the ridge.
basis: MP: 'Once at the parking lot (same lot for Piano Keys Bouldering Area), hike west up the hogback for 5 minutes'; parking area 'on the east side of Centennial Dr., 1/2 mile north of CR-38E (or 1 mile south of CR-42C)'.

note: Turn onto Airport Road and follow it 2.5 miles to the locked gate; park there without blocking the gate, then walk the dirt road past the second gate and take the faint trail left toward the lake.
basis: MP Long Point (Summersville Lake, WV): 'Turn on to Airport Road and follow it for 2.5 miles to the locked gate. Park here (don't block the gate).'

note: A larger lot sits at the base of Palisade Head on Hwy 61 with a trail to the top, and a small lot is near the summit. Parking is very tight in blueberry season, so arrive early; climbers need a Tettegouche State Park permit.
basis: MP forum posts: larger lot at base with trail to top, small lot near peak; 'arriving early is the best way to get a spot' in blueberry season; climbing permit from Tettegouche State Park office. Gate closures during past shutdowns noted.

note: Options include street parking on Sheldon (downhill side) and Moore Hill, or the Timberlin Park lot with a trail north to the cliff. Do not block driveways or mailboxes, and obey no-parking signs.
basis: MP Main Cliff Getting There: 'Parking is available on Sheldon (downhill side) and Moore Hill'; 'Timberlin Park. Follow trail north'; avoid blocking mailboxes or driveways.

note: Access is through the double gate and gravel road to the newly built parking area; lock the gate behind you. The land is private with a climbing easement, so check current gate and parking conditions before going.
basis: Search summary: MP route page 'current access is now via the new double gate and gravel road', 'lock the gate'; Access Fund/Touchstone: new gate, parking area, trailhead and 200 tons of gravel for new parking area.
